The /agents/deployments/prompt API provides a response in the following format:

200 Success

UpdateAgentDeploymentResponse Model - Response returned when a follow-up prompt is accepted by a deployment.
success boolean
Indicate if the API request was successful.
errors string Array
List of errors with the API call.
message string
example: Prompt run started.
Confirmation message returned by the platform.
Example 
{
  "success": true,
  "errors": [
    "string"
  ],
  "message": "Prompt run started."
}

401 Authentication Error

UnauthorizedError Model - Unauthorized response from the API. Key is missing, invalid, or timestamp is too old for hash.
www_authenticate string
Header
